monthEnd.computeCloseBody: Shows revenue and expense balances for {period} and the net result rolling into retained earnings. Nothing is posted.
monthEnd.computedCloseToast: Close computed: {lines} lines, net result {net}. No journal entry was posted.
monthEnd.lockBody: Locks transactions dated on or before {date}. A soft lock lets an owner or accountant post with a reason; a hard lock blocks all posting.
monthEnd.overrideChecklist: Lock even though the checklist is incomplete
monthEnd.reasonRequired: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters.
monthEnd.checklistIncomplete: The close checklist is incomplete. Tick the override and give a reason to lock anyway.
monthEnd.lockChecklistUnavailable: The close checklist status is unavailable. Refresh the checklist and review it before locking the period.
monthEnd.unlockBody: Re-opens transactions on or before {date}. The reason is audit-logged. A hard-closed year can only be reopened by your firm or an administrator.
monthEnd.runValidationHint: Run the checks to see what is left.
monthEnd.checklistLoadFailed: The checklist could not be loaded. Nothing has been confirmed for this period.
monthEnd.checklistEmpty: No checklist items were returned for this period.
monthEnd.historyLoadFailed: Close history could not be loaded, so locked periods may not be shown.
monthEnd.historyRefreshFailed: Close history could not be refreshed. The periods already loaded are still shown below.
monthEnd.historyWaitingToLoad: Waiting for a connection to load close history…
monthEnd.historyWaitingForConnection: Waiting for a connection to retry close history…
monthEnd.checklistWaitingForConnection: Waiting for a connection to retry the checklist…
monthEnd.checklistRefreshFailed: The checklist could not be refreshed. The items already loaded are still shown below.
monthEnd.checklistWaitingToLoad: Waiting for a connection to load the checklist…
monthEnd.summaryReady: Ready to close. All {total} checks passed. You can preview the close and lock the period.
